subject: prd/forgejo-feature-draft
statement: FR-4 requires retaining abandonment semantics, but its fit criterion verifies only the reason record and DOD-1 does not exercise abandonment. The existing affirmative repository-policy precondition and required human review/abandon transition therefore lack blocking PRD DoD evidence. False, missing, malformed, or inaccessible policy observations could mutate the reason Learning, branch or proposal while the current DoD still passes.
